Welcome to Anime Hunter!

🗺️ Explore a map full of anime themed locations and references from over 20 different anime!

🧍‍♂️ Collect characters, and unlock pets and auras!

🔎 There are currently 510 anime characters! Can you find them all?

👍 Like ⭐ Favorite 🔔 Follow for more updates!

The remastered version of "Find The Anime Characters"
